summary: Unpredictable single insert performance due to blocking and excessive indexing.
symptoms: Single insert operations occasionally take several minutes.
Blocking sessions appear in `sys.dm_exec_requests` but the blocking session ID does not correspond to an active query.
mechanism: Excessive indexing combined with blocking due to uncommitted transactions or lock contention.

facts.evidence: The post explicitly mentions the table has 34 indexes.
The post describes blocked sessions with no active queries.
The post explicitly mentions the wait type.

assumptions: The table schema includes a clustered index and 34 non-clustered indexes.
The blocking is caused by uncommitted transactions or lock contention.
unknowns: Exact schema of the table and indexes.
Whether the blocking sessions are caused by uncommitted transactions or other factors.
